title: 甲骨文30年债：收益率近8%，谁在承担AI融资压力？
speaker: Ben Bennett

segments.en: Sorry, sorry. It was not to like about the earnings. They're crazy, aren't they? In terms of, even if you strip out some of those big one-offs, US earnings are still on a year-on-year basis, 20, 30, 40 percent picking numbers. It's just huge.
segments.zh: 抱歉，盈利方面没什么不喜欢的。它们很疯狂，不是吗？即使剔除一些一次性项目，美国企业的盈利同比仍有20%、30%、40%的增长。非常巨大。

segments.en: So we still like that. And we still like the technology sector on the back of those earnings coming through. Whether or not they're sustainable, that's hard to say, but it's also a question in one year's time. So in the meantime, you've got those terrific earnings and you've got valuations on a P.E. basis that don't look that bad or certainly don't look anything like what we saw in the .com bubble.
segments.zh: 所以我们仍然看好。基于这些盈利，我们也仍然看好科技板块。这些盈利是否可持续很难说，但一年后也会有同样的问题。与此同时，你有强劲的盈利，而且市盈率估值看起来并不差，肯定不像互联网泡沫时那样。

segments.en: So you're comfortable still staying long on the equity side of the whole AI trade, but what about the credit side? Yeah, so that's the really interesting part of the AI trade because they are having to fund this investment. And I spoke before about Kevin Warsh, like maybe tapping the brakes on some of the investment to say, look, if you do too much, interest rates are going to have to come up.
segments.zh: 所以你仍然愿意在AI交易中保持权益多头，但信用方面呢？是的，这是AI交易中真正有趣的部分，因为他们需要为这些配置融资。我之前提到凯文·沃什，他可能会对部分配置踩刹车，说如果做得太多，利率就会上升。

segments.en: And at that point, it becomes more expensive for you to build your data center. And again, this is all very sensible policy making from my perspective. But if I'm lending this to the creditors of the AI, I have to also be comfortable that they will be able to make money on this. It's interesting that six months ago, I didn't want to lend money to the hyperscalers because the yields were too low, but now the markets moved.
segments.zh: 那时建设数据中心的成本会更高。在我看来，这都是非常合理的政策。但如果我要借钱给AI的债权人，我也必须确信他们能从中赚钱。有趣的是，六个月前我不想借钱给超大规模企业，因为收益率太低，但现在市场已经变了。

segments.en: I mean, if you look at Oracle's 30 year bond, which was issued the back end of last year for 100 basis points over treasuries, that's now more like 250 basis points. That yielding nearly 8% Oracle's an investment grade name, nearly 8% for 30 years, you know, that's starting to be interesting, isn't it? So there's always a valuation, and when you've got valuation and discipline, that's a perfect, that's a perfect marriage, I think.
segments.zh: 比如甲骨文的30年期债券，去年年底发行时利差为100个基点，现在大约250个基点。收益率接近8%，甲骨文是投资级，30年接近8%，这开始变得有趣了，不是吗？所以估值总是存在的，当估值和纪律结合时，我认为是完美的结合。
